findings.title: Restore native composer focus and atom selection when clicking a formal reference
findings.trigger: With a persisted formal reference between "before " and "after", focus #whiteboard, click the reference name, then type Z.
findings.actual: New reference-content button prevents pointerdown default and propagation in both states, and formal onClick has no action. Focus stays on #whiteboard, native Selection is empty, and typing Z leaves request text "before after".
findings.expected: Original f3269b8 formal span focuses #instruction and selects the reference atom from before-text offset 7 through after-text offset 0; typing Z yields "before Zafter". Restore the original native click selection/input behavior while preserving same geometry, preview confirmation, and existing editor-focus caret behavior.
findings.reproduced: Current failure observed in 390/1440 light/dark; direct original/current two-file private comparison confirms regression.
findings.rootFix: Shared ordinary span; formal content has no pointer interception, role or tabIndex, so browser-native editor focus and atom selection apply. Preview alone provides accessible confirmation semantics and click/Enter/Space handling.
findings.finalResult: Exact original Range and before Zafter persisted in all 8 original width/theme/focus cases; extra 6 image native atom replacements also passed.

verification.formalSequentialTabOrder: More -> editor -> remove -> Send; reverse Shift+Tab returns editor. Formal content has no extra stop.
verification.computedStyleBoundary: Cursor differs as required by preview confirmation role; every geometry, font, truncation and non-color painted property matches. All color derivatives recorded in review-reacceptance-measurements.json.
